The glass holds a translucent yellow liquid filled to roughly two-thirds, with a pale, rounded ice cube floating in the lower-right portion of the drink. A faint band of condensation clings to the upper exterior of the glass, catching the warm indoor light. The thick base glows yellow where the liquid pools. Throughout the captured moment, the visible arrangement appears largely unchanged: the rim, the liquid meniscus, and the floating cube stay in much the same positions.
